migration.reason: Retire automatic workspace/change-local layout migration, fence publication/retry and old-writer sealing from ordinary named path resolution. Keep the original case fields/source and full old assertions; current named resolution never enumerates unrelated changes, preserves source bytes/directories and creates no fence or authoritative target. Existing markers are inert and their foreign targets are never followed. Business Run/history/checkpoint and true Archive WAL/receipt imports use explicit import/Doctor and original business approvals; this is not a claim that the removed implicit-migration protocol still works.
